# Onion seeds

Type: Seed | Internal ID: OnionSeeds | Source: Found in huts or ruins in the, Mountain | Usage: Farming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Produces: 3, Onions | Grow Time (s): 4000-5000 | Needs Cultivated Ground?: Yes | Space Needed (m): 1 | Hospitable Biomes: Meadows, ,, Black Forest, , and, Plains

# Introduction

Onion seeds can be planted using the Cultivator in order to grow 1x Onion.

## Availability

• Onion seeds are found in Mountain Tower and Abandoned Cabins in the Mountain. Picked seeds won't respawn.
• Three seeds can be obtained by planting an Onion using the Cultivator option "Seed-onion".
• Coral Cod have a chance to drop 1-2 seeds when caught

Categorias: Seeds, Farming
